title: Wall Mount Double Glass Shelf 16-Inch With Gallery Rail Solid Brass | Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade bathroom storage with a wall mount glass shelf that provides two tiers for organizing everyday essentials. This double glass shelf includes 3/8-inch thick tempered glass and a gallery rail designed to help keep items in place—ideal as a bathroom shelf, vanity shelf, or wall shelf for toiletries.

Highlights:
- Double shelf design maximizes vertical storage in a compact area
- Tempered glass (3/8-inch thick) for safety and strength
- Solid brass hardware
- Gallery rail helps keep items secure
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean installation

Specs:
- Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 inches
- Overall dimensions: 16 inches (L) x 5 inches (W) x 8 inches (H); projection 5 inches
- Weight capacity: 4 lb
- Mounting type: wall mount
- Assembly required: no
- Included items: glass shelf and all installation hardware; screws #8 x 1 1/4

Coordinates with the waverly place collection for transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories, and is offered in multiple designer finish options.
